verdict.rationale: PayPal provides a documented sandbox environment mirroring production (paypal-docs-11) plus REST APIs, webhooks, and a Disputes API for programmatic dispute handling (paypal-docs-7, paypal-docs-9, paypal-docs-26). However, evidence doesn't detail specific test card numbers for every decline/dispute scenario, and community reports raise concerns about real-world dispute/chargeback handling unpredictability, suggesting gaps between sandbox simulation and production behavior.
